name: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden, UT) Roasted Turkey Breast & Havarti Panini on Sourdough
brandOrRestaurant: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden / Ogden Valley, UT)
whyItWorks: Lean sliced roast turkey breast with creamy Havarti cheese pressed on toasted sourdough bread. Sourdough is easy on digestion and Havarti is naturally low in lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Turkey Panini on sourdough with mayo; hold raw red onions or mustard.
